LanguageData.LP_Class_Fighter.label: fighter
LanguageData.LP_Class_Fighter.description: A weapon master at home in melee or at range, spending fighting spirit on bursts of action.\nPower: melee abilities use martial power (Strength or Dexterity, Melee); ranged abilities use marksman power (Dexterity, Shooting).
LanguageData.LP_Class_Monk.label: monk
LanguageData.LP_Class_Monk.description: An unarmed master of ki: fast strikes, strong evasion, deadliest up close.\nPower: martial power (Dexterity or Strength, Melee); ki effects also scale with psychic sensitivity. Strongest unarmed or with a quarterstaff.
LanguageData.LP_Class_Paladin.label: paladin
LanguageData.LP_Class_Paladin.description: A holy warrior bound by an oath, fighting in front while healing and shielding allies.\nPower: smites use martial power (Strength or Dexterity, Melee); healing and auras use divine power (Charisma or Wisdom, Social). Liches cannot become paladins.
